title: Who is who in Indigo
back: Gandhi, Rajkumar Shukla (tenacity), Rajendra Prasad and the lawyers (fees → jail), C. F. Andrews (refused help), with J. B. Kripalani, Kasturba and Dr Dev in support.

title: Indigo in six beats
back: Lucknow → 15% swindle → quit order → Motihari crowd and dropped case → 25 per cent → schools and self-reliance.

title: The peasant who would not give up
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Rajkumar Shukla follows Gandhi across India, 1916–17" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><g><circle cx="70" cy="87.1" r="12.1" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/><path d="M53.5,107.19999999999999 Q70,99.19999999999999 86.5,107.19999999999999 L83.86,138.8 L76.6,138.8 L77.92,185 H71.65 L70.66,141.0 H69.34 L68.35,185 H62.08 L63.4,138.8 L56.14,138.8 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/></g><g><circle cx="150" cy="118.25" r="8.25" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.7" stroke="none"/><path d="M138.75,134.5 Q150,126.5 161.25,134.5 L159.45,153.5 L162.375,185 H157.875 L151.125,162.5 L143.25,185 H138.3 L145.5,153.5 L140.55,153.5 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.7" stroke="none"/></g><path d="M90,60 L230,60 M221.2,64.8 L230,60 L221.2,55.2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><text x="160" y="48" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Lucknow → Cawnpore → Ahmedabad → Calcutta</text><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">Rajkumar Shukla follows Gandhi across India, 1916–17</text></svg>
back: Poor, thin, illiterate — and resolute. His tenacity, not an argument, brought Gandhi to Champaran. Mention the trail of cities.

title: Fifteen per cent for indigo
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Indigo as rent — until German dye killed the market" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><g transform="translate(100,160) scale(1.2)"><path d="M0,0 C-30,-30 -30,-80 0,-100 C30,-80 30,-30 0,0 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none"/><path d="M0,0 V-96" fill="none" stroke="#E0B400" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></g><rect x="170" y="60" width="110" height="100" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3"/><rect x="170" y="145" width="110" height="15" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.8" stroke="none"/><text x="225" y="110" text-anchor="middle" font-size="24" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">15%</text><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">Indigo as rent — until German dye killed the market</text></svg>
back: Tenants had to grow indigo on 15% of their land and surrender the harvest as rent. Synthetic indigo made it worthless, so landlords charged peasants compensation to cancel the clause — the swindle.

title: Order to quit Champaran
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="On an elephant to a maltreated peasant — stopped by a notice" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><path d="M60,160 V100.6 Q60,74.2 90.0,74.2 H144.0 Q180,74.2 177.6,100.6 Q192.0,127.0 174.0,146.8 Q165.6,156.7 168.0,160 H150.0 V136.9 H132.0 V160 H108.0 V136.9 H84.0 V160 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none"/><g><circle cx="130" cy="65.5" r="5.5" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/><path d="M122.5,79.0 Q130,71.0 137.5,79.0 L136.3,89.0 L133.0,89.0 L133.6,110 H130.75 L130.3,90.0 H129.7 L129.25,110 H126.4 L127.0,89.0 L123.7,89.0 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/></g><g><rect x="220" y="60" width="70" height="46" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none" rx="3"/><path d="M220,60 L255.0,85.3 L290,60 Z" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/></g><text x="255" y="140" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="700" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">I will disobey</text><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">On an elephant to a maltreated peasant — stopped by a notice</text></svg>
back: A police messenger overtook him; the notice ordered him out at once. Gandhi signed the receipt and wrote that he would disobey. The first act of civil disobedience in India.

title: Motihari turns black with peasants
back: Thousands gathered spontaneously at the courthouse; the officials needed Gandhi's cooperation. Concrete proof that British might could be challenged by Indians. Then: guilty by conscience, no bail, case dropped.

title: Fifty asked, twenty-five accepted
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Money mattered less than surrendered prestige" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="40" y="120" width="240" height="30" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3"/><rect x="40" y="120" width="120" height="30" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.3" stroke="none"/><rect x="40" y="120" width="60" height="30" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/><text x="70" y="100" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">25%</text><text x="130" y="100" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.6" stroke="none">50%</text><g transform="translate(250,60) rotate(-30) scale(0.9)"><rect x="-30" y="-14" width="60" height="28" fill="currentColor" stroke="none" rx="6"/><path d="M0,14 L0,60" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></g><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">Money mattered less than surrendered prestige</text></svg>
back: Gandhi accepted a quarter because the landlords had been obliged to give back money and prestige; the peasants learnt they had rights. Within a few years the planters abandoned their estates.

title: No Englishman as a prop
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Why Gandhi sent C. F. Andrews away" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><g><circle cx="160" cy="78.2" r="13.2" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/><path d="M142.0,99.4 Q160,91.4 178.0,99.4 L175.12,134.6 L167.2,134.6 L168.64,185 H161.8 L160.72,137.0 H159.28 L158.2,185 H151.36 L152.8,134.6 L144.88,134.6 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/></g><g><circle cx="260" cy="87.1" r="12.1" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.3" stroke="none"/><path d="M243.5,107.19999999999999 Q260,99.19999999999999 276.5,107.19999999999999 L273.86,138.8 L266.6,138.8 L267.92,185 H261.65 L260.66,141.0 H259.34 L258.35,185 H252.08 L253.4,138.8 L246.14,138.8 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.3" stroke="none"/><path d="M241.85,81.05 H278.15 V76.21 H270.89 V62.89999999999999 H249.11 V76.21 H241.85 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.3" stroke="none"/></g><path d="M215,80 L300,80" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="6 6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><text x="100" y="60" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="700" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">free India</text><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">Why Gandhi sent C. F. Andrews away</text></svg>
back: Relying on a sympathetic Englishman would show weakness; the cause was just and Indians must win it themselves. Champaran taught self-reliance as well as fearlessness.

title: When the lawyers chose jail
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Line to remember" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><g><rect x="28" y="36" width="264" height="72" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.08" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" rx="10"/><path d="M50,108 L42,122 L64,108 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/><text x="160.0" y="77.25" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">The battle of Champaran is won</text></g><text x="160" y="146" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.8" stroke="none">— Gandhi, before any verdict</text><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">Line to remember</text></svg>
back: The lawyers, ashamed to desert the peasants when a stranger faced prison, vowed to follow him to jail. That conversion, not the court, was the victory.
